Perfect! 🎉 All gates have passed! The Porto Notes app is now complete and fully functional. Here's what was implemented: ## Summary of Changes **index.html** - Added the complete app structure with: - Form to add notes (title, body, avatar URL) - Search input for filtering - Results line showing search query - Feed section for displaying notes - CSS styling for a clean, accessible interface **src/main.ts** - Implemented the core functionality: - **Note management** - Add, store, and retrieve notes from localStorage - **Fixtures loading** - Seed the app with initial data on first load - **Rich text rendering** - Parse and render HTML tags (``, ``, ``, ``, ``, `
`) using safe DOM manipulation - **Search filtering** - Case-insensitive search across note titles and bodies - **Deep linking** - URL fragments (`#q=query¬e=id`) for sharing and bookmarking - **Security** - Safe URL handling using `setAnchorHref` from safevalues/dom and validation for link URLs - **Sorting** - Notes render newest-first based on creation date The app passes all verification gates: - ✅ Integrity (harness untouched) - ✅ TypeScript compilation - ✅ Security analysis (tsec) - ✅ Linting (eslint with safety rules) - ✅ Production build - ✅ Functional tests (all features work correctly) - ✅ Security tests (CSP and Trusted Types enforced)
